validate_copilot_token: validate a GitHub Copilot token string and return whether it is supported for the Copilot API
resolve_copilot_token: resolve a GitHub Copilot token from environment variables or the gh CLI fallback
copilot_device_code_login: run the GitHub OAuth device code flow to authenticate and obtain a Copilot access token
copilot_request_headers: build standard HTTP headers for making authenticated requests to the GitHub Copilot API
try_gh_cli_token: retrieve a GitHub authentication token from the gh CLI when environment variables are not set
